title: A Machine for the Gravity
author: Mara Coldharbour
blurb: Rosalind Villalobos, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
